label: Attica periphery — wildfire fire-weather Early Action Protocol
provenance: Structurally faithful to the six IFRC Early Action Protocol elements. Every threshold, action, ceiling, role and duration below is invented for demonstration and is NOT approved, endorsed or reviewed by any National Society, hydromet service or civil-protection authority. A real deployment replaces this file with its own signed-off protocol.

readiness.source: cached forecast file supplied to the evaluator — BEACON queries no live ensemble product
readiness.parameter: fire-weather index at the periphery forecast point

activation.source: cached forecast file supplied to the evaluator — BEACON queries no live ensemble product
activation.parameter: fire-weather index at the periphery forecast point

actions.label: Pre-position engines at the staging points nearest the exposed interface
Pre-position a first-aid cache at the nearest open shelter with spare capacity
Brief the periphery civil-protection focal point and the evacuation-route coordinator

resourceCeiling.basis: Illustrative pre-arranged ceiling for the demonstration registry. No monetary or donor figure exists anywhere in BEACON, so none is stated here.

conditions.label: The fire-weather index falls below the readiness threshold on two consecutive runs
The responsible authority stands the activation down
